# 建模三个模块的图注（改写稿）

覆盖 Model 模块（wiki 七页）、Engineering、Description §1.5 三处的全部图片。每张图一条图注：Figure n. 与标题句粗体不斜体，其后说明不粗不斜，只陈述图里有的内容（坐标轴、标度、系列与颜色、色带、参考线、图上标出的数值、固定住的参数），不写推断。三处共用的 4 张图用同一条图注，唯一允许的差别是方程编号（只有 Model 页给方程编号）。六张图片内部原本带推断句或失效引用，已重出，新图附在对应图注上方。本仓库画的每一张图现在都同时输出 SVG 与 PDF 矢量图，三份 Word 里嵌的是“PNG + SVG”两层，Word 2016 以上与 WPS 按矢量渲染，旧版本退回 300 dpi 的 PNG。

（本文件与 `Model_Figure_Legends.docx` 同源同内容，由 `build_figure_legends_docx.py` 一次写出两份。重出的图以 SVG 内嵌在本文件里，单独一个 .md 就能看图，不依赖阅读器的 Word SVG 支持；GitHub 网页版会过滤内嵌图片，那里看图请用下面给出的文件路径。）

## 一、Model 模块（wiki 七页）

### Gate Calibration

`https://2026.igem.wiki/suda-icpi-china/model/`

**top summary chart, “Gate interaction by timepoint” (currently uncaptioned)**　｜　原编号：—

**Figure 1. Gate interaction estimate at each measurement time.** Bars give the interaction term of the probit-additive gate model at 6, 9 and 24 h, with standard-error whiskers and the estimate printed at each bar: +0.284 ± 0.240, +1.135 ± 0.350 and −0.011 ± 0.157. The vertical axis is the interaction term in probit units, and zero on it is exact multiplicative behaviour.

**circuit schematic under “Circuit and measured inputs”**　｜　原编号：Figure 1

改好的图（需上传替换 wiki 上的旧图）：乳酸构件下面原来印的是“lldPDR”，操纵子与零件都是“lldPRD”（lldP、lldR、lldD），全项目其余文档都这么写，图与自己的图注打架。这张图是别处做的位图，仓库里没有矢量源，所以只把那一个标签按原底色、原位置重排（`fix_circuit_label.py`），别处一个像素没动；收到时的原图留在 outputs/figures/source/ 备查。要矢量仍得找做图的同学导出 SVG。

![fig1_circuit](data:image/png;base64,)

**Figure 2. The two-input AND gate.** Hypoxia (Input 1) drives LuxI from pPepT, and LuxI makes the diffusible AHL that enters the integration step as Input A; lactate (Input 2) drives LuxR from the native lldPRD operon promoter, entering as Input B. The two together form the LuxR–AHL complex, which opens pLux on the effector, and the output is GSDMD-N and pyroptosis. Arrows are transcription or diffusion; the chassis drawn throughout is E. coli Nissle 1917.

### Growth & SsrA

`https://2026.igem.wiki/suda-icpi-china/model/growth-ssra/`

**top summary chart, “SsrA biomass–potency decision” (currently uncaptioned)**　｜　原编号：—

**Figure 3. Measured potency ratios against the keep-tag threshold.** Bars give the untagged-over-tagged potency ratio in the three same-dose co-culture comparisons, printed at each bar: 0.888 at 6 OD, 1.062 at 8 OD and 1.414 at 10 OD. The horizontal axis is that ratio on a linear scale, and the marked line at 1.710 is the threshold of Eq. (23), the reciprocal of the measured untagged-to-tagged biomass ratio 0.585.

**Figure 5. Tumour-over-site output ratio of each designed sensor arm at six off-target sites.** Each pair of bars gives the ratio of that arm's output in the tumour core to its output at the site named on the left, on a logarithmic axis: blue is the lactate arm, orange the hypoxia arm. **Figure 6. Sobol indices for the bottleneck margin and for the colonic-mucosa margin.** Left: first-order (circles) and total-order (squares) indices for nine parameters, computed on log10 of the tumour-over-site ratio so that the multiplicative model becomes additive (Eq. Right: the same total-order index at the colonic mucosa (blue) against the bottleneck site (orange), with native repression and luminal EcN density labelled absent from the mucosa model.

**Figure 7. Equivalent isolated radius of a cluster of 150 µm micro-lesions against the number of lesions in it.** Clusters of 1 to 512 lesions are arranged on a cubic lattice at three centre-to-centre spacings, one series each; the horizontal axis is logarithmic. ### Dose & Efficacy

`https://2026.igem.wiki/suda-icpi-china/model/efficacy/`

**first figure, “Killing goes as roughly the cube of dose” / “Reaching a micro-lesion spends the safety margin”**　｜　原编号：Figure 6

新图（已重出，需上传替换 wiki 上的旧图）：底注删去“CT26 needs 1.3-1.8x the highest dose tested…”，改为两幅图各自的参数与band；右图标注去掉“— under the line”；旧图底注的 19.6× 已更新为 21.85×，并补上 10× 要求线与 150 µm 标注点。

![fig4_6_dose_requirement](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

矢量图 `outputs/figures/vector/fig4_6_dose_requirement.svg`（另有同名 `.pdf`）

**Figure 8. Dose–kill relation, and the escalation and remaining margin against lesion radius.** Left: net CT26 killing over 24 h against co-culture dose, logarithmic axes. Points are measurements net of the GFP control with standard-error bars, the shaded band the doses tested, the line a power-law fit of exponent 2.65 (Eq. (43)), and the horizontal bands the target effect sizes (Eq. (44)), 0.12–0.69 % (human) and 29.3–50 % (CT26). Right: fold change against lesion radius, logarithmic — circles the escalation that radius needs, squares the colonic-mucosa margin left, priced on 21.85-fold. The dashed line at 10 is the required margin, that at 1 none left, the dotted vertical at 178 µm the smallest radius with a hypoxic core; the circled 150 µm point reads 4.95-fold dose, 4.41-fold margin left.

**second figure, “Distant lesion outcome vs immune pressure” / “Feasibility boundary”**　｜　原编号：Figure 7

矢量图 `outputs/figures/vector/fig6_immune_feasibility.svg`（另有同名 `.pdf`）

**Figure 9. Equilibria against immune pressure, and the feasibility boundary at εG = 1.** Left: steady states of Eq. (51) at h = 0.20, the escape burden (blue) and the largest burden still cleared (orange) as fractions of capacity, against immune pressure Ψ. Dashed verticals at Ψ = 1 and Ψ_crit = 1.80 bound the shaded region labelled bistable, and are labelled eradication possible and eradication guaranteed; the region to their right is labelled no escape state. Right: the εG = 1 boundary (Eq. (52)) on logarithmic axes of cascade gain G and immune permissiveness ε; the grey region below it is labelled infeasible at any pyroptotic flux, and the shaded horizontal band marks the MSS/pMMR range. Neither G nor ε is measured for this system.

## 五、修改意见（本表之外要人工做的）

- 图号三处各编各的，这是对的：Engineering 与 Description 是独立文档，Model 模块是一份跨七页连排的文档。合稿时只需保证同一张图在各自文档里被正文以 (Fig. n) 点到一次。
- Model 模块的七页正文里一个 (Fig. n) 都没有——Engineering 与 Description 已经做到了（构建会因为漏引而失败），wiki 那七页还得人工补。
- Model 模块若采纳本表的连排编号（Fig. 1–10），三张汇总图要一并上号；改动涉及 wiki 的 alt 文本与正文引用，建议和补 (Fig. n) 一次做完。
- 矢量图只覆盖本仓库画的 7 张。Model 页的 fig1_circuit（Figure 2）是别处做的位图，这次只改了图里那个拼错的标签，整张图要矢量仍得找做图的同学导出 SVG；wiki 上那三张汇总图本来就是 SVG。
- 图里的字体是 matplotlib 默认的 DejaVu Sans，发表惯例更常用 Arial/Helvetica。这台机器上有 Liberation Sans（与 Arial 等宽等距）与 Nimbus Sans（Helvetica 克隆），要换一行 rcParams 的事，但会动到全部 7 张图的外观，没有人拍板之前没动。
- SVG 里的文字是以路径输出的（matplotlib 的 svg.fonttype 默认），好处是任何机器上渲染都与我们看到的一致、不会被替换字体，代价是文字不可选中、不可在 AI/Inkscape 里直接改字。若合稿时需要可编辑文字，改成 svg.fonttype='none' 重出，但届时要确保对方机器上装了同一款字体。

### 本轮已处理

- `DOC_STANDARD.md` §5 的图注条款已改写（原文是“图注说明这张图回答 §0 的第几问”，与现行“只陈述事实”的尺子相反）：现在写明粗体/不斜体的排法、只陈述图里有的内容、不写推断、130 词上限、同图同注只许差方程编号、图内不许有推断句、图一律出矢量。
- fig1_circuit 图内的 lldPDR 已改成 lldPRD，见上面 Model Figure 2 的新图；wiki 上那张要一起换掉。
